source.locator: Install; Quick start; Use any provider; Modes; Features; Tool approval; Zen mode

observations: Describes an interactive or headless terminal agent and publishes an npm install route with macOS, Linux and Windows platform binaries.
Documents provider login or API keys, concrete prompts and JSON output, MCP integration, plan/act modes and checkpoint undo.
Tool approval section says tool calls are auto-approved by default; --auto-approve false requests review, and terminal required-approval calls are denied without a TTY.
Documents authentication failure without saved credentials and history inspection for background sessions; Zen mode is incompatible with --data-dir and --tui.
Links official documentation, community support and feature requests. Listing source revision does not prove an installed binary matches it.
